proposals.before: Jiang Province governor Prince Jin'an Zixun rebelled and the four quarters rose in response. Mian, retaining his existing office, served as adjutant on the pacification staff of Prince Pingling Jingsu and advanced to hold Liang Mountain.
proposals.after: Jiang Province governor Prince Jin'an Zixun rebelled and the four quarters rose in response. Mian, retaining his existing office, served as adjutant on the pacification staff of Prince Jianping Jingsu and advanced to hold Liang Mountain.
proposals.reason: Chinese 建平王 is Prince of Jianping, not Pingling.

proposals.before: In former times Wang Yun held fast to sincerity and Bian Huai had stern integrity. Both matched the virtue of the past and return glory to the former track.
proposals.after: In former times Wang Yun held fast to sincerity and Bian Kun had stern integrity. Both matched the virtue of the past and return glory to the former track.

decisions.reason: s0061 建平王景素 is Prince Jianping Jingsu; Pingling misreads 建平 and the proposed Jianping wording is accurate.
s0061 建平王景素 is Prince of Jianping Jingsu; Pingling is a false reading of 建平 and the proposed replacement matches the Chinese.
s0139 巴陵、建平二王 names the princes of Baling and Jianping; Pingping is not in the Chinese and Jianping restores 建平.
s0139 建平 is Jianping; the before's Pingping invents a title absent from 巴陵、建平二王, and the proposed fix is correct.
s0161 卞壼 is Bian Kun (pinyin Kǔn); Bian Huai is a wrong English name, and the proposed Bian Kun correctly matches the person named in the Chinese.
